propositions: Successfully posted outbound Jira comments were not having their returned comment IDs recorded in the local comment_ids map, creating a silent invariant violation visible in production state

A post-succeeds-but-comment_ids-unchanged divergence must be observed in 2 consecutive reconcile passes before firing an alert, implementing N-of-M debounce philosophy rather than per-pass immediate firing
Every successful comment post must be counted at the shared _record_comment_id enactment seam independent of whether recording succeeds, capturing posts that fail to record their returned IDs
Cross-pass debounce state persists in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json and corrupt or absent state must fail open to counter 0 without breaking the pass
Alert records appended to bridge_alerts via alert_store must name the invariant and pass_id, deduped with 24h key bridge-alert:comment-id-divergence
